cases.description: a named fun (`fun erlang:abs/1`) is a first-class value that applies

cases.description: io_lib:format/2 returns the formatted text as a deep list

cases.description: lists:usort/1 removes duplicates and collapses arithmetic-equal elements

cases.description: the fun-taking lists BIFs run through the -eval `FunCaller` seam

cases.description: phash2/1 across the small-int sign/magnitude byte-scan boundaries (2^27-1, 2^27 and their negatives)
cases.eval: try ({erlang:phash2(134217727), erlang:phash2(134217728), erlang:phash2(-134217727), erlang:phash2(-134217728)}) of V -> io:format("ok ~w~n", [V]), halt(0) catch C:R -> io:format("exception ~w ~w~n", [C, R]), halt(1) end.

cases.description: phash2/1 and phash/2 of 0.0 / -0.0 (the legacy hash normalises the sign) plus a plain float
cases.eval: try ({erlang:phash2(0.0), erlang:phash2(-0.0), erlang:phash(0.0, 1000000), erlang:phash(-0.0, 1000000), erlang:phash2(1.5)}) of V -> io:format("ok ~w~n", [V]), halt(0) catch C:R -> io:format("exception ~w ~w~n", [C, R]), halt(1) end.

cases.description: phash2/1 of bitstrings whose bit size is not a multiple of 8 (the partial final-byte step)

cases.description: phash2/1 of a single-key map (which routes through the other hash) and of an external fun

cases.description: split/2,3 on a compiled {bm,_}/{ac,_} handle: first-only by default, global/trim via options, subject unchanged when there is no match
